title: Bus Stop Barometer
summary: E-ink display by the front door showing the next buses and whether to take an umbrella.

data.text: A small e-ink screen on a Raspberry Pi that refreshes every two minutes with the next three buses from the nearest stop and a one word weather verdict.
The fun constraint was e-ink: slow refreshes and no colour meant designing a layout that is useful from across the hall in one glance.
